normal.label: Chance per normal kill
normal.description: How often a normal monster's kill drops a map. 0.03 is three in a hundred; 1 drops one every kill.

unique.label: Chance per unique kill
unique.description: Unique monsters, a map's boss among them. 1 means every boss leaves a map.

followMap.label: Drop the open map's tier
followMap.description: On: a kill in a map drops a map of that map's tier (the same tier the server's own roll uses). Off: the tier below, everywhere.

tier.label: Tier outside a map
tier.description: The tier dropped in the campaign and in hideouts, and in maps when "Drop the open map's tier" is off.

monsters.label: Only these monsters
monsters.description: Leave empty for every monster. Otherwise the variety id or the name must contain one of these (case does not matter).
